### A Willing Heart - Girlfriends in God
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-mar-11-2009-11600550.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 5:20
Points:
- Believers are commissioned as Christ's ambassadors to bring His message of reconciliation to the hurting.
- God does not need our human credentials, expertise, or personal strength to do His work.
- The Lord asks for an obedient and willing heart rather than self-reliance.
- When we step out in faith to speak His truth, God displays His power through us.

### How to Represent Christ in Our Culture
Author: Jason Soroski
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/how-to-represent-christ-in-our-culture.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 5:20
Points:
- Christians are citizens of heaven stationed on earth to represent Christ's kingdom.
- Heavenly identity must take precedence over earthly allegiances, politics, and preferences.
- Believers may use earthly rights and opportunities strategically to advance the gospel.
- Following Christ means expecting opposition and trial rather than earthly diplomatic immunity.
- An ambassador must consistently mirror Jesus and proclaim reconciliation wherever they are placed.
